verdict.rationale: First-party docs say LM Studio serves local models on OpenAI-like endpoints, locally and on the network. The server starts from the CLI with `lms server start`/`lms server stop` or headless via llmster, and models load on demand when a request arrives. Community users independently confirm the OpenAI-compatible server makes it easy to spin up and test any loaded model. missing for 10: detailed evidence of exact OpenAI endpoint coverage and compatibility (e.g., which routes and parameters match OpenAI's API).
